# Saharan AI — Video Transitions Skill

> Open-source Agent Skill by Saharan AI (https://www.saharan.ai) that teaches AI agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, others) 40 professional video transitions, each with steps, use cases, effect, a ready-to-use AI prompt, AI path (editing / code / generative video), suggested duration, pitfalls and sources. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

## Files
- [SKILL.md](skills/video-transitions/SKILL.md): agent instructions and decision guide
- [transitions.md](skills/video-transitions/references/transitions.md): all 40 techniques
- [transitions.json](skills/video-transitions/references/transitions.json): machine-readable data
- [sources.md](skills/video-transitions/references/sources.md): 28 cited sources

## About
Saharan AI is an agentic creative canvas, like an agentic Canva: one full-stack AI agent runs the whole creative workflow end to end. https://www.saharan.ai
